materialAnalysisReviewed: Scott identifies a counterweight to the existing Rams pass-rush advantage: Brock Purdy posted a 9.0% pressure-to-sack rate in 2025, lowest among qualifying quarterbacks, despite a 3.23-second average time to throw. That suggests Myles Garrett/Aaron Donald pressure may not translate cleanly into sacks. The Rams' clearer defensive path is to win early downs, force third-and-long and make San Francisco throw deep: only 9.9% of Purdy's 2025 attempts traveled 20+ yards, and his 17.6% turnover-worthy-play rate on deep throws was second-worst among qualifying quarterbacks. Scott's mechanism is therefore to disrupt Kyle Shanahan's script and force Purdy into a lower-frequency, higher-variance deep-passing mode rather than expecting the pass rush alone to dominate.
